        }


        // 修改插件选择处理函数
        function handlePluginSelection(pluginType) {
            const messageInput = document.getElementById('message-input');
            const selection = window.getSelection();
            const range = selection.getRangeAt(0);
            
            // 获取当前文本和@的位置
            const text = messageInput.textContent;
            const atMatch = text.match(/@[^@\s]*$/);
            
            if (atMatch) {
                // 创建插件标签
                const config = pluginConfig[pluginType];
                if (!config) return;


                const tagSpan = document.createElement('span');
                tagSpan.className = `plugin-tag ${config.class}`;
                tagSpan.contentEditable = 'false';
                tagSpan.dataset.type = pluginType;  // 添加插件类型数据
                
                // 特殊处理微信文章插件
                if (pluginType.startsWith('weixin')) {
                    tagSpan.textContent = `@${config.text}`;
                    tagSpan.dataset.url = config.url;
                } else {
                    tagSpan.textContent = `@${config.text}`;
                }


                // 替换@及其后面的文本
                const textNode = Array.from(messageInput.childNodes).find(node => 
                    node.nodeType === 3 && node.textContent.includes('@')
                );
                
                if (textNode) {
                    const beforeAt = textNode.textContent.substring(0, textNode.textContent.lastIndexOf('@'));
                    textNode.textContent = beforeAt;
                    
                    // 插入新节点
                    const space = document.createTextNode(' ');
                    const newTextNode = document.createTextNode('');
                    
                    messageInput.insertBefore(tagSpan, textNode.nextSibling);
                    messageInput.insertBefore(space, tagSpan.nextSibling);
                    messageInput.insertBefore(newTextNode, space.nextSibling);
                    
                    // 设置光标位置
                    const newRange = document.createRange();
                    newRange.setStart(newTextNode, 0);
                    newRange.collapse(true);
                    selection.removeAllRanges();
                    selection.addRange(newRange);
                }
            }
            
            // 隐藏提示框
            document.querySelector('.search-tooltip').style.display = 'none';
            messageInput.focus();
        }


        // 修改 collectPluginQueries 函数
        function collectPluginQueries() {
            const messageInput = document.getElementById('message-input');
            const plugins = {};
            let currentTag = null;
            let currentQuery = '';
            
            // 遍历所有节点
            Array.from(messageInput.childNodes).forEach(node => {
                if (node.nodeType === 1 && node.classList.contains('plugin-tag')) {
                    // 如果有之前的标签和查询，保存它
                    if (currentTag && currentQuery.trim()) {
                        if (!plugins[currentTag]) {
                            plugins[currentTag] = [];
                        }
                        plugins[currentTag].push(currentQuery.trim());
                    }
                    // 开始新的标签
                    currentTag = node.dataset.type;
                    currentQuery = '';
                } else if (node.nodeType === 3 && currentTag) {
                    // 收集文本内容直到下一个标签
                    currentQuery += node.textContent;
                }
            });
            
            // 处理最后一个标签的查询
            if (currentTag && currentQuery.trim()) {
                if (!plugins[currentTag]) {
                    plugins[currentTag] = [];
                }
                plugins[currentTag].push(currentQuery.trim());
            }
            
            return plugins;
        }


        // 修改插件结果处理函数
        function createPluginResultPanel(type, content, query = '') {
            console.log('Creating plugin panel:', { type, content, query });
            
            const panel = document.createElement('div');
            panel.className = `plugin-result-panel ${type}`;
            
            const header = document.createElement('div');
            header.className = 'plugin-result-header';
            
            let title;
            let contentHtml;
            
            switch (type) {
                case 'url':
                    title = '网页内容总结';
                    if (content && typeof content === 'object' && !content.error) {
                        contentHtml = `
                            <div class="url-content">
                                <h4>网页标题</h4>
                                <div class="url-title">${content.title || '无标题'}</div>
                                
                                <h4>网页地址</h4>
                                <div class="url-link">
                                    <a href="${content.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${content.url}</a>
                                </div>
                                
                                <h4>原始内容</h4>
                                <div class="raw-content">${marked.parse(content.raw_content || '')}</div>
                                
                                <h4>AI 总结</h4>
                                <div class="content-summary">${marked.parse(content.summary || '')}</div>
                            </div>
                        `;
                    } else {
                        contentHtml = `<div class="error-message">${content.error || '处理网页内容失败'}</div>`;
                    }
                    break;
                case 'print':
                    title = '文本打印结果';
                    contentHtml = `
                        <div class="print-result">
                            ${marked.parse(content)}
                        </div>
                    `;
                    
                    // 应用代码高亮
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        panel.querySelectorAll('pre code').forEach((block) => {
                            hljs.highlightBlock(block);
                        });
                    }, 0);
                    break;
                case 'calc':
                    title = '计算结果';
                    contentHtml = `
                        <div class="calc-result">
                            <div class="calc-expression">${query}</div>
                            <div class="calc-answer">${content}</div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                    break;
                case 'magnet':
                    title = '磁力搜索结果';
                    if (content && content !== "未找到相关磁力链接") {
                        const results = content.split('\n\n');
                        let html = '<div class="magnet-results">';
                        
                        for (let i = 0; i < results.length; i += 3) {
                            if (!results[i]) continue;
                            
                            const title = results[i].replace('电', '').trim();
                            const name = results[i + 1]?.replace('磁力名称:', '').trim() || '';
                            const link = results[i + 2]?.trim() || '';
                            
                            if (title && link) {
                                html += `
                                    <div class="magnet-item">
                                        <div class="magnet-title">${name || title}</div>
                                        <div class="magnet-link-container">
                                            <div class="magnet-link-text">${link}</div>
                                            <button class="copy-button" data-link="${link}">
                                                <span class="copy-icon">📋</span>
                                                复制链接
                                            </button>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                `;
                            }
                        }
                        
                        html += '</div>';
                        contentHtml = html;
                        
                        // 添加复制功能
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            panel.querySelectorAll('.copy-button').forEach(button => {
                                button.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                                    const link = e.currentTarget.dataset.link;
                                    navigator.clipboard.writeText(link).then(() => {
                                        const btn = e.currentTarget;
                                        btn.classList.add('copied');
                                        btn.innerHTML = '<span class="copy-icon">✓</span>已复制';
                                        setTimeout(() => {
                                            btn.classList.remove('copied');
                                            btn.innerHTML = '<span class="copy-icon">📋</span>复制链接';
                                        }, 2000);
                                    });
                                });
                            });
                        }, 0);
                    } else {
                        contentHtml = '<div class="no-results">未找到相关磁力链接</div>';
                    }
                    break;
                case 'weixin1':
                    title = '微信文章内容';
                    content = `<div class="weixin-content">${content}</div>`;
                    break;
                default:
                    title = '插件结果';
                    contentHtml = `<div class="plugin-content">${content}</div>`;
            }
            
            header.innerHTML = `
                <div class="header-content">${title}${query ? `: "${query}"` : ''}</div>
                <svg class="result-toggle" width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12">
                    <path d="M6 8L2 4h8L6 8z" fill="currentColor"/>
                </svg>
            `;
            
            const contentDiv = document.createElement('div');
            contentDiv.className = 'plugin-result-content';
            contentDiv.innerHTML = contentHtml;
            
            panel.appendChild(header);
            panel.appendChild(contentDiv);
            
            header.addEventListener('click', () => {
                contentDiv.classList.toggle('expanded');
                header.querySelector('.result-toggle').classList.toggle('expanded');
            });
            
            return panel;
        }


        // 格式化磁力搜索结果
        function formatMagnetResults(content) {
            if (content === "未找到相关磁力链接") {
                return '<div class="no-results">未找到相关磁力链接</div>';
            }
            
            const results = content.split('\n\n');
            let html = '';
            
            for (let i = 0; i < results.length; i += 3) {
                if (!results[i]) continue;
                
                const title = results[i].replace('电影名:', '');
                const name = results[i + 1]?.replace('磁力名称: ', '') || '';
                const link = results[i + 2]?.replace('磁力:', '') || '<br>';
                
                if (title && link) {
                    html += `
                        <div class="magnet-item">
                            <div class="magnet-name">${name || title}</div>
                            <div class="magnet-link-container">
                                <div class="magnet-link-text">${link}</div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }
            }
            
            return html || '<div class="no-results">未找到相关磁力链接</div>';
        }


        // 显示复制提示
        function showCopyTip(element, text) {
            const tip = document.createElement('div');
            tip.className = 'copy-tip';
            tip.textContent = text;
            
            element.appendChild(tip);
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                tip.classList.add('show');
            }, 0);
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                tip.classList.remove('show');
                setTimeout(() => tip.remove(), 200);
            }, 1000);
        }


        // 修改更新上下文和历史记录函数
        function updateContextAndHistory(message, data) {
            // 更新上下文
            currentContext.push({ role: 'user', content: message });
            
            // 创建消息数组
            const messages = [{ role: 'user', content: message }];
            
            if (data.responses && data.responses[0]) {
                currentContext.push({ role: 'assistant', content: data.responses[0] });
                messages.push({ role: 'assistant', content: data.responses[0] });
            }
            
            // 保存到历史记录
            const historyItem = {
                id: Date.now().toString(),
                time: new Date().toLocaleString(),
                messages: messages,
                searchResults: data.search_results || [],
                responses: data.responses || []
            };
            
            // 获取现有历史记录
            let history = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('chatHistory') || '[]');
            history.unshift(historyItem); // 在开头添加新记录
            
            // 限制历史记录数量
            const maxHistoryItems = 50;
            if (history.length > maxHistoryItems) {
                history = history.slice(0, maxHistoryItems);
            }
            
            localStorage.setItem('chatHistory', JSON.stringify(history));
            
            // 更新历史记录列表
            updateHistoryList();
        }


        // 修改历史记录列表更新函数
        function updateHistoryList() {
            const chatHistory = document.querySelector('.chat-history');
            if (!chatHistory) return;


            try {
                chatHistory.innerHTML = '';
                
                const encryptedHistory = localStorage.getItem('conversations');
                let history = encryptedHistory ? 
                    CryptoUtil.decrypt(encryptedHistory) : [];


                if (!Array.isArray(history) || history.length === 0) {
                    chatHistory.innerHTML = '<div class="history-empty">暂无聊天记录</div>';
                    return;
                }


                // 按时间戳倒序排序
                history.sort((a, b) => {
                    // 获取最后一条消息的时间戳
                    const timeA = a.messages?.length ? 
                        new Date(a.messages[a.messages.length - 1].timestamp).getTime() : 
                        new Date(a.time).getTime();
                    const timeB = b.messages?.length ? 
                        new Date(b.messages[b.messages.length - 1].timestamp).getTime() : 
                        new Date(b.time).getTime();
                    return timeB - timeA;  // 倒序排序
                });


                history.forEach(item => {
                    if (!item.messages || item.messages.length === 0) return;


                    const div = document.createElement('div');
                    div.className = 'history-item';
                    if (item.id === currentConversationId) {
                        div.classList.add('active');
                    }


                    // 获取对话标题和预览
                    const firstUserMsg = item.messages.find(m => m.role === 'user');
                    const title = firstUserMsg ? firstUserMsg.content : '新对话';
                    
                    // 获取最新的问答对
                    const recentMessages = item.messages.slice(-4).reduce((acc, msg) => {
                        if (msg.role === 'user') {
                            acc.questions.push(msg.content);
                        } else if (msg.role === 'assistant') {
                            acc.answers.push(msg.content);
                        }
                        return acc;
                    }, { questions: [], answers: [] });


                    // 创建预览内容
                    const preview = `
                        <div class="history-content">
                            <div class="history-questions">
                                <div class="history-label">最新问题:</div>
                                ${recentMessages.questions.slice(-2).map(q => 
                                    `<div class="history-text">${q.slice(0, 50)}${q.length > 50 ? '...' : ''}</div>`
                                ).join('')}
                            </div>
                            <div class="history-answers">
                                <div class="history-label">最新回答:</div>
                                ${recentMessages.answers.slice(-2).map(a => 
                                    `<div class="history-text">${a.slice(0, 50)}${a.length > 50 ? '...' : ''}</div>`
                                ).join('')}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;


                    const formattedTime = new Date(item.time).toLocaleString('zh-CN', {
                        year: 'numeric',
                        month: '2-digit',
                        day: '2-digit',
                        hour: '2-digit',
                        minute: '2-digit'
                    });


                    div.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="history-header">
                            <div class="history-title">${title.slice(0, 30)}${title.length > 30 ? '...' : ''}</div>
                            <div class="history-time">${formattedTime}</div>
                            ${item.messages.some(m => m.plugin_queries || m.search_results) ? 
                                '<div class="history-plugin-indicator" title="包含插件使用">🔌</div>' : ''}
                        </div>
                        ${preview}
                    `;


                    div.onclick = () => loadConversation(item);
                    chatHistory.appendChild(div);
                });


            } catch (error) {
                console.error('更新历史记录列表失败:', error);
                chatHistory.innerHTML = '<div class="history-error">加载历史记录失败</div>';
            }
        }


        // 修改清空历史记录功能
        function clearHistory() {
            if (confirm('确定要清空所有聊天记录吗？此操作不可恢复。')) {
                try {
                    // 清空本地存储
                    localStorage.removeItem('conversations');
                    
                    // 清空当前聊天内容
                    const chatMessages = document.querySelector('.chat-messages');
                    if (chatMessages) {
                        chatMessages.innerHTML = '';
                    }
                    
                    // 重置状态
                    currentContext = [];
                    currentConversationId = null;
                    
                    // 清空输入框
                    const messageInput = document.getElementById('message-input');
                    if (messageInput) {
                        messageInput.innerHTML = '';
                    }
                    
                    // 更新历史记录列表
                    updateHistoryList();
                    
                    // 自动开始新对话
                    this.startNewChat();
                    
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('清空历史记录失败:', error);
                    alert('清空历史记录失败: ' + error.message);
                }
            }
        }


        // 修改清空历史按钮事件绑定
        document.querySelector('.clear-history').onclick = function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            
            if (confirm('确定要清空所有聊天记录吗？此操作不可恢复。')) {
                clearHistory();
            }
        };


        // 构建上下文
        function buildContext() {
            const messages = [];
            const messageElements = chatMessages.querySelectorAll('.message');
            
            messageElements.forEach(element => {
                const content = element.querySelector('.message-content').textContent;
                const role = element.classList.contains('user') ? 'user' : 'assistant';
                messages.push({ role, content });
            });
            
            return messages;
        }


        // 添加AI响应
        function addAIResponse(text) {
            const messageDiv = document.createElement('div');
            messageDiv.className = 'message ai';
            
            const contentDiv = document.createElement('div');
            contentDiv.className = 'message-content markdown-body';
            messageDiv.appendChild(contentDiv);
            
            chatMessages.appendChild(messageDiv);
            typeText(text, contentDiv);
        }


        // 添加总结部分
        function addSummary(text) {
            const summaryDiv = document.createElement('div');
            summaryDiv.className = 'message ai summary';
            
            const contentDiv = document.createElement('div');
            contentDiv.className = 'message-content markdown-body';
            summaryDiv.appendChild(contentDiv);
            
            const summaryContent = `**总结：**\n${text}`;
            chatMessages.appendChild(summaryDiv);
            typeText(summaryContent, contentDiv);
        }


        // 打字效果
        function typeText(text, element, speed = 20) {
            clearTimeout(typingTimer);
            const tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
            let index = 0;
            
            function type() {
                try {
                    if (index < text.length) {
                        tempDiv.innerHTML = marked.parse(text.substring(0, index + 1));
                        element.innerHTML = tempDiv.innerHTML;
                        index++;
                        typingTimer = setTimeout(type, speed);
                    } else {
                        element.innerHTML = marked.parse(text);
                        // 确保 hljs 已加载
                        if (typeof hljs !== 'undefined') {
                            hljs.highlightAll();
                        }
                    }
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('Typing error:', error);
                    element.innerHTML = marked.parse(text);
                }
            }
            
            type();
        }


        // 保存到历史记录
        function saveToHistory(message, data) {
            try {
                // 获取并解密现有历史记录
                const encryptedHistory = localStorage.getItem('conversations');
                let history = encryptedHistory ? 
                    CryptoUtil.decrypt(encryptedHistory) : [];
                
                if (!Array.isArray(history)) history = [];
                
                let conversation = history.find(c => c.id === currentConversationId);
                
                if (!conversation) {
                    conversation = {
                        id: currentConversationId,
                        time: new Date().toLocaleString(),
                        messages: []
                    };
                    history.unshift(conversation);
                }


                // 保存用户消息
                const userMessage = {
                    role: 'user',
                    content: message,
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                    plugin_queries: data.plugin_queries
                };
                
                // 保存AI回复
                const aiMessage = {
                    role: 'assistant',
                    content: data.message,
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                    search_results: data.search_results
                };


                conversation.messages.push(userMessage, aiMessage);
                
                // 加密并保存历史记录
                const encryptedData = CryptoUtil.encrypt(history);
                localStorage.setItem('conversations', encryptedData);
                
                // 更新历史记录列表
                updateHistoryList();
                
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('保存历史记录失败:', error);
            }
        }


        // 错误处理
        function handleError(error, message = '服务出现错误，请稍后重试') {
            console.error('Error:', error);
            addMessage(message, 'ai');
            scrollToBottom();
        }


        // 滚动到底部
        function scrollToBottom() {
            chatMessages.scrollTop = chatMessages.scrollHeight;
        }


        // 添加搜索提示框相关变量
        let searchTooltip = document.querySelector('.search-tooltip');
        let searchType = null;
        let isSearchMode = false;


        // 修改输入框事件监听
        messageInput.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
            // 更新发送按钮状态
            updateSendButtonState();
            
            // 获取当前光标位置的文本节点
            const selection = window.getSelection();
            const range = selection.getRangeAt(0);
            const node = range.startContainer;
            
            // 如果不是文本节点，隐藏提示框并返回
            if (node.nodeType !== 3) {
                searchTooltip.style.display = 'none';
                return;
            }
            
            // 获取当前节点中光标之前的文本
            const cursorPosition = range.startOffset;
            const beforeCursor = node.textContent.substring(0, cursorPosition);
            
            // 检查@后面的文本
            const atMatch = beforeCursor.match(/@([^@\s]*)$/);
            if (!atMatch) {
                // 如果没有@或已经输入了空格，隐藏提示框
                searchTooltip.style.display = 'none';
                return;
            }
            
            const searchText = atMatch[1]?.toLowerCase() || '';
            
            // 过滤匹配的插件
            const filteredPlugins = Object.entries(pluginConfig)
                .filter(([key, config]) => {
                    return config.text.toLowerCase().includes(searchText) || 
                           config.keywords.some(k => k.toLowerCase().includes(searchText));
                })
                .map(([key, config]) => ({
                    type: key,
                    ...config
                }));


            if (filteredPlugins.length > 0) {
                // 显示提示框
                searchTooltip.innerHTML = filteredPlugins
                    .map((plugin, index) => `
                        <div class="search-tooltip-item ${index === 0 ? 'active' : ''}" data-type="${plugin.type}">
                            <div class="plugin-title">
                                ${getPluginIcon(plugin.type)} ${plugin.text}
                            </div>
                            <div class="tooltip-description">${plugin.description}</div>
                        </div>
                    `).join('');
                
                // 定位提示框
                const inputRect = this.getBoundingClientRect();
                searchTooltip.style.display = 'block';
                searchTooltip.style.left = '10px';
                searchTooltip.style.bottom = `${inputRect.height + 10}px`;
            } else {
                searchTooltip.style.display = 'none';
            }
        });


        // 添加键盘事件监听，处理退格键
        messageInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Backspace') {
                // 获取当前选区
                const selection = window.getSelection();
                const range = selection.getRangeAt(0);
                const node = range.startContainer;
                
                // 如果删除后没有@符号，隐藏提示框
                if (node.nodeType === 3) {
                    const cursorPosition = range.startOffset;
                    const textBeforeCursor = node.textContent.substring(0, cursorPosition);
                    if (!textBeforeCursor.includes('@')) {
                        searchTooltip.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                }
            }
        });


        // 修改键盘事件处理
        messageInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            const isPluginSelecting = searchTooltip.style.display === 'block';
            
            // 检查是否有未完成的插件输入
            const hasIncompletePlugin = Array.from(this.querySelectorAll('.plugin-tag')).some(tag => {
                const nextNode = tag.nextSibling;
                const query = nextNode ? nextNode.textContent.trim() : '';
                return !query;
            });


            if (isPluginSelecting) {
                // 处理插件选择状态下的按键
                const items = Array.from(searchTooltip.querySelectorAll('.search-tooltip-item'));
                const currentActive = searchTooltip.querySelector('.search-tooltip-item.active');
                const currentIndex = items.indexOf(currentActive);


                switch (e.key) {
                    case 'Enter':
                        e.preventDefault(); // 阻止默认行为
                        if (currentActive) {
                            handlePluginSelection(currentActive.dataset.type);
                        }
                        return; // 直接返回，不执行发送消息
                        
                    case 'ArrowUp':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        const prevIndex = currentIndex > 0 ? currentIndex - 1 : items.length - 1;
                        items.forEach((item, i) => item.classList.toggle('active', i === prevIndex));
                        break;
                        
                    case 'ArrowDown':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        const nextIndex = currentIndex < items.length - 1 ? currentIndex + 1 : 0;
                        items.forEach((item, i) => item.classList.toggle('active', i === nextIndex));
                        break;
                        
                    case 'Escape':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        searchTooltip.style.display = 'none';
                        break;
                }
            } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                // 处理非插件选择状态下的 Enter
                e.preventDefault();
                
                // 检查是否有未完成的插件输入
                if (hasIncompletePlugin) {
                   // alert('请输入搜索内容'); //不用显示
                    return;
                }
                
                const message = this.textContent.trim();
                if (message) {
                    sendMessage();
                }
            }
        });


        // 修改插件标签插入函数
        function insertPluginTag(type) {
            const config = pluginConfig[type];
            if (!config) return;


            const messageDiv = document.getElementById('message-input');
            const selection = window.getSelection();
            const range = selection.getRangeAt(0);


            // 获取当前文本和@的位置
            const text = messageDiv.textContent;
            const atMatch = text.match(/@[^@\s]*$/);
            
            if (atMatch) {
                // 创建插件标签
                const tagSpan = document.createElement('span');
                tagSpan.className = `plugin-tag ${config.class}`;
                tagSpan.textContent = `@${config.text}`;
                tagSpan.contentEditable = 'false';


                // 创建空格和新文本节点
                const space = document.createTextNode(' ');
                const newTextNode = document.createTextNode('');


                // 替换@及其后面的文本
                const textNode = Array.from(messageDiv.childNodes).find(node => 
                    node.nodeType === 3 && node.textContent.includes('@')
                );
                
                if (textNode) {
                    const beforeAt = textNode.textContent.substring(0, textNode.textContent.lastIndexOf('@'));
                    textNode.textContent = beforeAt;
                    
                    // 插入新节点
                    messageDiv.insertBefore(tagSpan, textNode.nextSibling);
                    messageDiv.insertBefore(space, tagSpan.nextSibling);
                    messageDiv.insertBefore(newTextNode, space.nextSibling);
                    
                    // 设置光标位置
                    const newRange = document.createRange();
                    newRange.setStart(newTextNode, 0);
                    newRange.collapse(true);
                    selection.removeAllRanges();
                    selection.addRange(newRange);
                }
            }
            
            // 隐藏提示框
            searchTooltip.style.display = 'none';
            messageDiv.focus();
        }


        // 获取插件图标
        function getPluginIcon(type) {
            const icons = {
                'web': '🌐',
                'image': '🖼️',
                'url': '📄',
                'print': '🖨️',
                'calc': '🔢',
                'time': '⏰',
                'magnet': '🧲'
            };
            return icons[type] || '📎';
        }


        // 修改搜索提示框的事件绑定
        function setupSearchTooltip() {
            const searchTooltip = document.querySelector('.search-tooltip');
            const messageInput = document.getElementById('message-input');


            // 点击事件处理
            searchTooltip.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                const item = e.target.closest('.search-tooltip-item');
                if (item) {
                    handlePluginSelection(item.dataset.type);
                }
            });


            // 输入事件处理
            messageInput.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
                const text = this.textContent;
                const atMatch = text.match(/@([^@\s]*)$/);
                
                if (atMatch) {
                    const searchText = atMatch[1].toLowerCase();
                    const filteredPlugins = Object.entries(pluginConfig)
                        .filter(([key, config]) => {
                            return config.text.toLowerCase().includes(searchText) || 
                                   config.keywords.some(k => k.toLowerCase().includes(searchText));
                        });


                    if (filteredPlugins.length > 0) {
                        searchTooltip.innerHTML = filteredPlugins
                            .map(([key, config]) => `
                                <div class="search-tooltip-item" data-type="${key}">
                                    <div class="plugin-title">${getPluginIcon(key)} ${config.text}</div>
                                    <div class="tooltip-description">${config.description}</div>
                                </div>
                            `).join('');
                        
                        const inputRect = this.getBoundingClientRect();
                        searchTooltip.style.display = 'block';
                        searchTooltip.style.left = '10px';
                        searchTooltip.style.bottom = `${inputRect.height + 10}px`;
                    } else {
                        searchTooltip.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                } else {
                    searchTooltip.style.display = 'none';
                }
            });


            // 键盘事件处理
            messageInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                const isPluginSelecting = searchTooltip.style.display === 'block';
                
                if (isPluginSelecting) {
                    const items = Array.from(searchTooltip.querySelectorAll('.search-tooltip-item'));
                    const currentActive = searchTooltip.querySelector('.search-tooltip-item.active') || items[0];
                    const currentIndex = items.indexOf(currentActive);


                    switch (e.key) {
                        case 'Enter':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            if (currentActive) {
                                handlePluginSelection(currentActive.dataset.type);
                            }
                            break;
                            
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            items.forEach(item => item.classList.remove('active'));
                            const prevIndex = currentIndex > 0 ? currentIndex - 1 : items.length - 1;
                            items[prevIndex].classList.add('active');
                            break;
                            
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            items.forEach(item => item.classList.remove('active'));
                            const nextIndex = currentIndex < items.length - 1 ? currentIndex + 1 : 0;
                            items[nextIndex].classList.add('active');
                            break;
                            
                        case 'Escape':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            searchTooltip.style.display = 'none';
                            break;
                    }
                }
            });
        }


        // 在 DOMContentLoaded 事件中调用
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            chatApp.init();
            setupSearchTooltip();
            updateSendButtonState();
        });


        // 添加获取光标坐标的辅助函数
        function getCaretCoordinates(element, position) {
            const range = document.createRange();
            const sel = window.getSelection();
            
            // 创建一个临时文本节点来获取位置
            let textNode = Array.from(element.childNodes).find(node => 
                node.nodeType === 3 && node.textContent.includes('@')
            );
            
            if (!textNode) {
                return { left: 0, top: 0 };
            }
            
            range.setStart(textNode, position);
            range.setEnd(textNode, position);
            
            // 获取范围的边界框
            const rect = range.getBoundingClientRect();
            const elementRect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
            
            return {
                left: rect.left - elementRect.left,
                top: rect.top - elementRect.top
            };
        }


        // 修改历史记录点击事件
        function setupHistoryItemClick(historyItem, element) {
            if (!element || !historyItem) return;
            
            element.onclick = function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                
                console.log('点击历史记录项:', historyItem);
                
                // 添加加载状态
                this.classList.add('loading');
                
                try {
                    // 确保 historyItem 有效
                    if (!historyItem || !historyItem.messages) {
                        throw new Error('无效的历史记录');
                    }
                    
                    // 确保消息格式正确
                    const validMessages = historyItem.messages.every(msg => 
                        msg && typeof msg.content === 'string' && 
                        (msg.role === 'user' || msg.role === 'assistant')
                    );
                    
                    if (!validMessages) {
                        throw new Error('历史记录格式不正确');
                    }
                    
                    // 调用 chatApp 的 loadHistory 方法
                    window.chatApp.loadHistory(historyItem);
                    
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('处理历史记录点击失败:', error);
                    alert('加载历史记录失败: ' + error.message);
                } finally {
                    // 移除加载状态
                    this.classList.remove('loading');
                }
            };
        }


        // 添加发送按钮状态处理函数
        function updateSendButtonState() {
            const messageInput = document.getElementById('message-input');
            const sendButton = document.getElementById('send-button');
            const messageContent = messageInput.textContent.trim();
            
            if (sendButton) {
                sendButton.disabled = !messageContent;
                sendButton.style.opacity = messageContent ? '1' : '0.5';
                sendButton.style.cursor = messageContent ? 'pointer' : 'not-allowed';
            }
        }


        // 添加输入事件监听
        messageInput.addEventListener('input', updateSendButtonState);


        // 添加音乐结果面板创建函数
        function createMusicResultPanel(results, query) {
            const panel = document.createElement('div');
            panel.className = 'music-results-panel';
            
            const header = document.createElement('div');
            header.className = 'music-results-header';
            header.innerHTML = `
                <div class="header-content">音乐搜索结果: "${query}"</div>
                <svg class="result-toggle" width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12">
                    <path d="M6 8L2 4h8L6 8z" fill="currentColor"/>
                </svg>
            `;
            
            const content = document.createElement('div');
            content.className = 'music-results-content';
            
            results.forEach(song => {
                const songItem = document.createElement('div');
                songItem.className = 'song-item';
                
                // 创建音乐播放器
                const audio = document.createElement('audio');
                audio.controls = true;
                audio.src = song.url;
                
                songItem.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="song-info">
                        <img class="song-cover" src="${song.pic}" alt="封面">
                        <div class="song-details">
                            <div class="song-title">${song.title}</div>
                            <div class="song-author">${song.author}</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="song-player"></div>
                    <div class="song-lyrics">${formatLyrics(song.lrc)}</div>
                `;
                
                songItem.querySelector('.song-player').appendChild(audio);
                content.appendChild(songItem);
            });
            
            panel.appendChild(header);
            panel.appendChild(content);
            
            header.addEventListener('click', () => {
                content.classList.toggle('expanded');
                header.querySelector('.result-toggle').classList.toggle('expanded');
            });
            
            return panel;
        }


        // 添加歌词格式化函数
        function formatLyrics(lrc) {
            if (!lrc) return '<div class="no-lyrics">暂无歌词</div>';
            
            const lines = lrc.split('\n')
                .map(line => {
                    const match = line.match(/^\[(\d{2}:\d{2}.\d{2,3})\](.*)/);
                    if (match) {
                        return `<div class="lyric-line">${match[2]}</div>`;
                    }
                    return '';
                })
                .filter(line => line);
                
            return lines.join('');
        }


        // 添加加密/解密工具函数
        const CryptoUtil = {
            // Base64 加密
            encrypt(text) {
                try {
                    return btoa(encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(text)));
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('加密失败:', e);
                    return '';
                }
            },


            // Base64 解密
            decrypt(encoded) {
                try {
                    return JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(atob(encoded)));
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('解密失败:', e);
                    return null;
                }
            }
        };


        // 添加文本高亮函数
        function highlightText(element, searchText) {
            const originalText = element.textContent;
            const regex = new RegExp(`(${searchText})`, 'gi');
            element.innerHTML = originalText.replace(regex, '<mark>$1</mark>');
        }


        // 添加搜索状态显示
        function updateSearchStatus(visibleCount, totalCount) {
            const statusDiv = document.querySelector('.search-status') || 
                createSearchStatus();
            
            if (visibleCount === totalCount) {
                statusDiv.style.display = 'none';
            } else {
                statusDiv.style.display = 'block';
                statusDiv.textContent = `显示 ${visibleCount}/${totalCount} 条记录`;
            }
        }


        // 创建搜索状态元素
        function createSearchStatus() {
            const statusDiv = document.createElement('div');
            statusDiv.className = 'search-status';
            const searchContainer = document.querySelector('.search-container');
            searchContainer.appendChild(statusDiv);
            return statusDiv;
        }
</script>
</body>
</html>

78. # 标题: Python爱心代码
 时间: 2025年01月03日 15:29
 内容: import pygame
import math
import colorsys
import random


# 初始化Pygame
pygame.init()


# 设置窗口
width = 800
height = 600
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((width, height))
pygame.display.set_caption('炫彩动态爱心')


# 爱心参数
scale = 10
angle = 0
center_x = width // 2
center_y = height // 2


# 粒子效果
class Particle:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y
        self.vx = random.uniform(-2, 2)
        self.vy = random.uniform(-2, 2)
        self.lifetime = random.randint(20, 40)
        self.color = (255, 255, 255)
        self.size = random.randint(1, 3)


    def update(self):
        self.x += self.vx
        self.y += self.vy
        self.lifetime -= 1
        self.vy += 0.1  # 重力效果


particles = []


# 主循环
running = True
clock = pygame.time.Clock()


def draw_heart(size, color, fill=True, thickness=2):
    points = []
    for t in range(0, 360, 1):
        rad = math.radians(t)
        x = 16 * math.sin(rad) ** 3
        y = 13 * math.cos(rad) - 5 * math.cos(2*rad) - 2 * math.cos(3*rad) - math.cos(4*rad)
        x = x * size + center_x
        y = -y * size + center_y
        points.append((x, y))
    
    if fill:
        pygame.draw.polygon(screen, color, points)
    else:
        pygame.draw.lines(screen, color, True, points, thickness)


while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False


    # 创建渐变背景
    for y in range(height):
        color = colorsys.hsv_to_rgb((y/height + angle/10) % 1, 0.3, 0.1)
        color = tuple(int(x * 255) for x in color)
        pygame.draw.line(screen, color, (0, y), (width, y))
    
    # 计算呼吸效果
    breath = math.sin(angle) * 0.2 + 0.8
    size = scale * breath
    
    # 获取主爱心颜色
    hue = (angle % 360) / 360
    main_color = colorsys.hsv_to_rgb(hue, 1, 1)
    main_color = tuple(int(x * 255) for x in main_color)
    
    # 绘制发光效果
    for i in range(3):
        glow_size = size * (1 + i * 0.1)
        glow_color = tuple(int(x * (0.5 - i * 0.15)) for x in main_color)
        draw_heart(glow_size, glow_color)
    
    # 绘制主爱心
    draw_heart(size, main_color)
    draw_heart(size, (255, 255, 255), False)  # 白色轮廓
    
    # 添加粒子效果
    if random.random() < 0.3:
        angle_rad = random.uniform(0, math.pi * 2)
        r = size * random.uniform(0.8, 1.2)
        px = center_x + math.cos(angle_rad) * r
        py = center_y + math.sin(angle_rad) * r
        particles.append(Particle(px, py))
    
    # 更新和绘制粒子
    for particle in particles[:]:
        particle.update()
        if particle.lifetime <= 0:
            particles.remove(particle)
        else:
            alpha = min(255, particle.lifetime * 6)
            particle_color = (255, 255, 255, alpha)
            particle_surface = pygame.Surface((particle.size * 2, particle.size * 2), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            pygame.draw.circle(particle_surface, particle_color, 
                             (particle.size, particle.size), particle.size)
            screen.blit(particle_surface, 
                       (particle.x - particle.size, particle.y - particle.size))
    
    # 更新显示
    pygame.display.flip()
    
    # 更新角度
    angle += 0.05
    
    # 控制帧率
    clock.tick(60)


# 退出程序
pygame.quit()

def should_search(message: str) -> bool:
    """智能判断是否需要搜索"""
    try:
        headers = {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {DEEPSEEK_API_KEY}"
        }
        
        prompt = """分析用户输入并判断是否需要搜索外部信息来回答。
只需要回答: "是" 或 "否"


判断标准:
1. 询问最新信息、新闻、图片、视频等需要搜索
2. 询问具体事实、数据、教程等需要搜索
3. 简单问候、闲聊、询问AI自身等不需要搜索


用户输入: {message}"""


        messages = [{
            "role": "system",
            "content": "你是判断助手，只返回是或否"
        }, {
            "role": "user",
            "content": prompt.format(message=message)
        }]
        
        payload = {
            "model": "deepseek-chat",
            "messages": messages,
            "temperature": 0.1,
            "max_tokens": 5
        }
        
        response = requests.post(
            DEEPSEEK_API_URL, 
            headers=headers, 
            json=payload,
            timeout=10
        )
        result = response.json()
        
        if 'choices' in result and len(result['choices']) > 0:
            return '是' in result['choices'][0]['message']['content']
            
        return False
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"判断搜索需求错误: {str(e)}")
        return False


def get_ai_response(message: str, context: List = None) -> str:
    """获取AI回答"""
    try:
        # 获取当前详细时间信息
        now = datetime.now()
        date_str = now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        time_str = now.strftime("%H:%M:%S")  # 24小时制的时分秒
        weekday_cn = ["星期一", "星期二", "星期三", "星期四", "星期五", "星期六", "星期日"][now.weekday()]
        
        # 确定时间段
        hour = now.hour
        if 5 <= hour < 12:
            period = "早上"
        elif 12 <= hour < 14:
            period = "中午"
        elif 14 <= hour < 18:
            period = "下午"
        elif 18 <= hour < 23:
            period = "晚上"
        else:
            period = "凌晨"
            
        time_info = f"""当前时间信息：
- 日期：{date_str} {weekday_cn}
- 时间：{time_str}
- 时段：{period}"""
        
        headers = {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {DEEPSEEK_API_KEY}"
        }
        
        messages = []
        if context:
            messages.extend(context)
            
        messages.extend([
            {
                "role": "system",
                "content": f"""你是一个专业、友好的AI助手。
{time_info}


请注意：
1. 基于当前具体时间提供准确、合适的回答
2. 在涉及时间的问题上要精确到秒
3. 平常聊天时请适当使用表情符号
4. 回答要全面且符合当前时间场景
5. 不要每次回答时提到当前时间，除非用户询问时间相关问题。
如果用户询问时间相关问题，请提供完整的时间信息。"""
            },
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": message
            }
        ])
        
        payload = {
            "model": "deepseek-chat",
            "messages": messages,
            "temperature": 0.7
        }
        
        response = requests.post(
            DEEPSEEK_API_URL,
            headers=headers,
            json=payload,
            timeout=30
        )
        result = response.json()
        
        if 'choices' in result and len(result['choices']) > 0:
            return result['choices'][0]['message']['content']
        else:
            return "抱歉，我没有得到有效的回复。请稍后重试。"
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"获取AI回答错误: {str(e)}")
        return "服务暂时不可用，请稍后再试。"


def search_web(query: str) -> List[Dict]:
    """执行网络搜索"""
    try:
        browser = mechanicalsoup.StatefulBrowser()
        browser.session.headers.update({
            'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36',
            'Accept': 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8',
            'Accept-Language': 'zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en;q=0.8'
        })
        
        url = f"https://www.bing.com/search?q={urllib.parse.quote(query)}"
        response = browser.open(url)
        page_content = browser.get_current_page()
        
        search_results = []
        for result in page_content.select('.b_algo'):
            title_elem = result.select_one('h2')
            link_elem = result.select_one('a')
            if title_elem and link_elem:
                try:
                    # 使用 mechanicalsoup 获取页面内容
                    page_response = browser.open(link_elem['href'], verify=False)
                    page_content = browser.get_current_page()
                    
                    # 清理HTML
                    for tag in page_content(['script', 'style']):
                        tag.decompose()
                    text = ' '.join(page_content.stripped_strings)
                    
                    search_results.append({
                        'title': title_elem.text,
                        'url': link_elem['href'],
                        'snippet': text # 限制摘要长度
                    })
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"获取URL内容错误 {link_elem['href']}: {str(e)}")
                    continue
                    
        return search_results[:5]  # 限制返回前5个结果
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"搜索错误: {str(e)}")
        return []


def search_images(query: str) -> List[Dict]:
    """执行图片搜索"""
    try:
        browser = mechanicalsoup.StatefulBrowser()
        browser.session.headers.update({
            'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36',
            'Accept': 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8',
            'Accept-Language': 'zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en;q=0.8'
        })
        
        url = 'https://cn.bing.com/images/search?q=' + urllib.parse.quote(query)
        response = browser.open(url)
        page_content = browser.get_current_page()
        
        results = []
        # 查找所有图片容器
        iusc_tags = page_content.find_all('a', class_='iusc')
        
        for tag in iusc_tags:
            # 使用正则表达式提取图片URL和标题
            murl = re.search(r'"murl":"([^"]+)"', str(tag))
            title = re.search(r'"t":"([^"]+)"', str(tag))
            
            if murl and title:
                results.append({
                    'type': 'image',
                    'title': title.group(1),
                    'url': murl.group(1),
                    'thumbnail': murl.group(1)
                })
                
                if len(results) >= 30:
                    break
                    
        return results
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"图片搜索错误: {str(e)}")
        return []


@app.route('/chat', methods=['POST'])
def chat():
    """处理聊天请求"""
    try:
        data = request.json
        message = data.get('message', '')
        session_id = data.get('session_id', str(uuid.uuid4()))
        context = data.get('context', [])
        
        # 判断是否需要搜索
        need_search = should_search(message)
        search_results = []
        ai_response = ""
        
        if need_search:
            # 判断是否是图片搜索
            is_image_search = any(keyword in message for keyword in ['图片', '照片', '图'])
            
            if is_image_search:
                # 图片搜索
                image_results = search_images(message)
                if image_results:
                    search_results = image_results
                    ai_response = "我找到了这些相关图片。"
            else:
                # 网页搜索
                web_results = search_web(message)
                if web_results:
                    search_results = web_results
                    # 构建搜索结果摘要
                    search_context = "基于以下搜索结果:\n\n"
                    for i, result in enumerate(web_results, 1):
                        search_context += f"{i}. {result['title']}\n{result['snippet']}\n\n"
                    
                    message_with_context = f"{search_context}\n请针对用户的问题 '{message}' 给出完整的回答。"
                    ai_response = get_ai_response(message_with_context, context)
        
        if not ai_response:
            ai_response = get_ai_response(message, context)


        response = {
            'status': 'success',
            'responses': [ai_response],
            'search_results': search_results if search_results else None,
            'session_id': session_id
        }


        # 更新会话历史
        sessions[session_id].extend([
            {
                'role': 'user',
                'content': message,
                'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat()
            },
            {
                'role': 'assistant',
                'content': ai_response,
                'search_results': search_results,
                'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat()
            }
        ])


        return jsonify(response)


    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"处理请求错误: {str(e)}")
        return jsonify({
            'status': 'error',
            'message': '服务器错误，请稍后重试'
        }), 500


# 添加错误处理路由
@app.errorhandler(404)
def not_found(error):
    return jsonify({'error': 'Not found'}), 404


@app.errorhandler(500)
def internal_error(error):
    return jsonify({'error': 'Internal server error'}), 500


if __name__ == '__main__':
    # 检查必要的目录是否存在
    if not os.path.exists(template_dir):
        os.makedirs(template_dir)
        logger.warning(f"Created template directory: {template_dir}")
    
    if not os.path.exists(static_dir):
        os.makedirs(static_dir)
        logger.warning(f"Created static directory: {static_dir}")
    
    # 检查模板文件是否存在
    template_file = os.path.join(template_dir, 'index.html')
    if not os.path.exists(template_file):
        logger.error(f"Template file not found: {template_file}")
        
    app.run(port=5000,debug=True)

    <div class="container">
        <!-- 菜单按钮 -->

        <!-- 侧边栏 -->
        <div class="sidebar">
